question: In Apache Log4j, attacker-controlled log content can trigger a directory lookup and load code from a remote server. Which CVE describes this?
In 1Panel, insufficiently filtered SQL injection can write arbitrary files and ultimately lead to code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache ActiveMQ, serialized message objects are accepted without restricting their classes, allowing code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache ActiveMQ, an authenticated console request can make the management bridge load a Spring XML context and invoke code during bean setup. Which CVE describes this?
In FFmpeg, an HLS playlist can make a remote request carry data from a local file. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache Struts, Dynamic Method Invocation lets a method-prefixed request reach chained expressions and code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache ActiveMQ, an HTTP upload followed by a move request can leave a remote file executable. Which CVE describes this?
In ImageMagick, specially prepared picture content can cause command execution through shell syntax. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache Shiro, leaving the cipher key unset for remember-me can permit code execution or an access-control bypass. Which CVE describes this?
In Spring Security OAuth, a crafted response_type value is evaluated as Spring SpEL and can trigger remote code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In PHPMailer, a crafted Sender value can add options to the mail command and execute code. Which CVE describes this?
In Zabbix, the toggle_ids array parameter can be used to inject SQL commands. Which CVE describes this?
In Zabbix, packets sent through an active proxy can reach trapper command handling and cause command injection. Which CVE describes this?
In Adobe ColdFusion, unsafe Java deserialization in its BlazeDS library can lead to code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Drupal, unsafe PHP-object handling by the PECL YAML parser can let a remote attacker execute code. Which CVE describes this?
In Samba, a client can place a library in a writable share and then induce the server to load that library as code. Which CVE describes this?
In JBossMQ, a messaging endpoint rebuilds attacker-chosen classes from incoming data without an allowlist, leading to execution on the server. Which CVE describes this?
In jackson-databind versions before 2.6.7.1, 2.7.9.1, and 2.8.9, malicious input passed to ObjectMapper.readValue() can let an unauthenticated user execute code. Which CVE describes this?
In Joomla, request handling lets an attacker inject database syntax and issue arbitrary SQL statements. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache Struts, the Struts 1 plugin can pass a malicious field in ActionMessage to remote code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache Solr, XML query parsing can expand external entities and read local files through an FTP wrapper. Which CVE describes this?
In Apache CouchDB, duplicate role fields can let a non-admin user grant itself administrator privileges. Which CVE describes this?
In Django, the technical 500 debug page disables HTML autoescaping, allowing cross-site scripting. Which CVE describes this?
In node-postgres, a malicious column name supplied by a query or database can cause code execution. Which CVE describes this?
In Ruby Net::FTP, a pipe-prefixed localfile makes the following command execute. Which CVE describes this?
